# Morning Briefing — Tue Nov 10, 2026
Written ~8:20 AM ET by BRIEFING. Live futures: Yahoo Finance chart API (~8:05 AM ET). Prior-session closes: Yahoo completed daily bars via desk prefetch cache (observation Nov 9 session). Paper only, no trades placed.

## ES/NQ bias, levels, overnight
- **Bias: neutral, wait for CPI (8:30).** Monday's ripping rebound (S&P +2.35%, Nasdaq +2.74%) is being digested; Dow leads, Nasdaq lags overnight. No y/y CPI this month (BLS lacks Oct 2025 data), so m/m (cons +0.3%, core +0.2%) carries the print.
- Overnight: ES ~7578.5 (+0.1% vs 7574.25 settle), range 7566–7598.75. NQ ~27913 (-0.4% vs 28014.5), range 27869–28109. VIX ~20.0 (Mon close 19.92). WTI ~$85.0 (-2.2%) on Trump saying Iran action "not necessary". 10y ~4.86% (Mon).
- ES: resistance 7599–7600.5 (ON high / Mon high), support 7566 (ON low) then 7469–7477 (Fri high). NQ: resistance 28109–28129, support 27869 then 27425 (Fri high).

## Prior day recap (Mon Nov 9)
Broad rebound: SPY 752.69 (+2.4%), QQQ 679.35 (+3.5%), VIX 19.92 (from 25.64). SOXX +7.5%, AMD best day in six months, but NVDA closed about -4% on the Huang probe plus a new class action. GLD 379.53 (+1.9%), TLT 81.96 flat. QQQ closed back just above the Oct 10-month SMA ($678.38).

## Desk activity
- No new fills. SB29 paper basket (SPY/TLT/GLD, $80 notional) marks ~$81.19 at Mon close (+$1.19); portfolio stop $72 far. Next action: Nov 30 rebalance.
- Watcher: running every 5 min, 0 alerts, 0 delivery failures through 8:15 AM.

scanner_skepticism.summary: Scores 4 under the unchanged C1-C5 method on REAL TQQQ data (2010-02 -> 2026-10); fails only C2 by 0.01 Sharpe (OOS 0.89 vs QQQ 0.80 + 0.10). SCANNER VIEW: DO NOT TRUST - recommend reject/park. Red flags: (1) in-sample is only 5.9y and contains NO bear market (2010-2015); (2) on a synthetic 3x-QQQ series calibrated to real TQQQ (daily corr 0.9990, extra drag 1.0%/yr), the same rules started 1999-12-31 lose -99.96% max drawdown in 2000-2009 (CAGR -44.0%/yr) - the buy-the-shortfall rule ends ~all-in TQQQ during a -83% Nasdaq crash; started 2007-06 the max drawdown is -92.3%; (3) real OOS max drawdown -65.4% (QQQ -35.1%), impossible to hold within the RISK_MANAGER limits at full size; (4) the edge over a plain constant-mix 60/40 TQQQ/AGG quarterly rebalance is modest (OOS Sharpe 0.89 vs 0.76) and over QQQ it disappears with rebalance-date timing luck (offset 21-42 sessions: Sharpe 0.80/0.80 = QQQ 0.80); (5) 2020-2022 Sharpe 0.31, CAGR 1.8%: the 2022 drawdown was survived only because the 30-down rule plus a fast 2023 rebound. Positive: rules are mechanical and published (Kelly Letter), 4 trades/yr, insensitive to 2x costs (0.89) and 1-bar lag (0.92), all 6 grid cells beat QQQ OOS. Score is reported as computed (no retroactive gate), but the synthetic long-history test is the decisive evidence: this is leveraged Nasdaq beta from the best decade on record, not a validated edge.
